Claim 13 (Currently amended): A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein said second connector is structured as a single unitary connector body that integrates both the respiratory gas passage and the contact elements__.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is __permanently attached to__ the flexible tube.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __and wherein the sheathing body comprises a multi-layer construction with the heater embedded between layers__.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __that is separate from and independent of the respiratory gas passage__.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __that is integrated into the flexible tube__.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __that extends externally from the flexible tube__.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and includes a water reservoir chamber__.

Claim 24 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

Claim 25 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.

Claim 26 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device __and wherein the contact elements are positioned radially outward from the gas passage__.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 28 (Previously presented): The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion.

Claim 29 (Currently amended): A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device __and wherein the contact elements are positioned radially outward from the gas passage__.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein each __contact element__ is provided within the second portion.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __and wherein the connector is formed as a single unitary body__.
